facts.fact: 当晚 David 和 Erin 在 Poughkeepsie 城外的休息站第一次做爱;此前他们沿 I-87 开了一个多小时。
facts.anchor: Later that night, David and Erin had sex for the first time at a rest stop outside Poughkeepsie. They’d driven down I-87 for over an hour

facts.fact: Erin 低声背出忽然想起的一首诗/童谣:「Alone. Underneath the stars. Lost somewhere in the cinematic universe.」
facts.anchor: “Alone. Underneath the stars. Lost somewhere in the cinematic universe.”

facts.fact: David 觉得 Erin 的话里带着怨:她似乎认为这一切都是 David 的错——不只 Jim 家发生的事,还有她电视上的信号、甚至 Public Access Afterworld 本身。
facts.anchor: as if somehow she now believed that all of this—not just the events back at Jim’s, but the signal on her television, even Public Access Afterworld itself—was all David’s fault somehow.

facts.fact: 做爱时 Erin 责备 David:你只是站在那里,没动、没帮忙,只顾着看。
facts.anchor: “You just stood there,” she whispered. “You didn’t move. You didn’t help. All you did was watch.”

facts.fact: Erin 在休息站洗手间里尖叫,对赶来的 David 说:海报上的那只怪物 Chimotera 来过。
facts.anchor: “The monster,” Erin said. “The monster from the poster. Chimotera.”

facts.fact: 当晚 David 在论坛 UncannyValley 的帖子——数周前被一位持怀疑态度的版主锁定——意外被重新开放。
facts.anchor: His UncannyValley message board thread, the one that had been locked weeks earlier by a skeptical mod, had, in an unlikely turn of events, been reopened.

facts.fact: 论坛 OG 管理员、前海军陆战队队员 Emily 在看 Ray “Can You Say Sunshine” Davino 的旧视频时,听到这位 weatherman 说出「Public Access Afterworld」。
facts.anchor: One of the board’s OG admins, an ex-marine named Emily who was well respected and even kind of feared for her boot camp–style moderation policies, had been watching old Ray “Can You Say Sunshine” Davino videos and heard the weatherman say “Public Access Afterworld” in one of the uploads.

facts.fact: 回复陆续涌来;到天亮,David 原先被锁的帖子已变成 megathread。
facts.anchor: The replies started rolling in. By dawn, David’s previously locked post had become a megathread.
